name: Clue/Cluedo: Painted Red Gallery Expansion
storyline:
The second-biggest shock of the week was Mr Boden “Boddy” Black announcing that, for one night only, his exclusive gallery would open to the public.

The biggest shock of all, however, was Boddy winding up dead a mere hour before the doors were due to open.

Only six people had early access to the gallery that night, so they’re on your list of possible suspects. But you have a unique way to tackle the case – the Double Reveal feature! Now, for every suggestion you make, you get not one but two responses!

Did Art Critic Scarlett regret auctioning off her integrity and decide to avenge herself with the gavel? Perhaps Gallery Security Guard Mustard tied up a loose end with the tie-down straps. Maybe Art Dealer Plum ended Boddy’s rise to power by using the power drill? Or did a panic-stricken assistant curator white lash out with the glass shard? Celebrity Influencer Green may have tried to cover his tracks with the art piece? Or maybe a sharp comment in a meeting saw Registrar Peacock reaching for the Display Katana?

It’s up to you to figure out whodunit, with what weapon and where – and you have to do it before anyone else!

As you progress, you’ll complete tasks in your case file and unlock themed cosmetics to match the artistic board.
